name: Dimitar Brankov (Bulgarian Industrial Association economist)
detail: Warns that a KNSB-style wealth tax could punish the middle class and saving; not a supporter.

name: Bulgarian Socialist Party (progressive income tax bills)
detail: BSP bills and alternative budgets (for example the April 2015 bill to replace the flat income tax) propose progressive income tax, not a tax on net wealth. A 2012 BSP discussion of a "wealth" tax (Capital, 24 Feb 2012) is open as a lead because the page blocks scripts.
